reason: Reviews only from guests who actually paid, plus knowing who my regulars are, is something I'd genuinely use in Sololaki with all the tourists. With three months free and 59 GEL after, it costs me nothing to try on a few tables.
objection: My waiters will fight anything that touches the bill and tips. If guests pay on their phone and the tip disappears or gets lost in the fee, I'll have a revolt, and I don't want to reconcile two payment streams every night when I check my totals.
would_change_my_mind: If the trial showed tips going down or the payment partner's fee was higher than my card terminal's, I would switch it off after the free months.
